stories.title: United Russia Secures Constitutional Majority in State Duma Election
stories.what_happened: The ruling United Russia party won 355 seats and 57.83% of the vote in the parliamentary election, the first since the invasion of Ukraine began. News18 reports that Ramzan Kadyrov was re-elected in Chechnya with 99.85% of the vote. Sources differ on turnout, reporting figures of 57%, 59%, and 59.3%.
stories.impact: The result solidifies the ruling party's control over the legislature.

stories.title: India and New Zealand Finalize Free Trade Agreement
stories.what_happened: India and New Zealand finalized a free trade agreement signed on April 27, 2026. The pact, which grants duty-free access to all Indian exports while excluding sensitive goods like dairy and sugar, takes effect on October 20, 2026. According to News18, the New Zealand Parliament approved the deal with a 93-29 vote and created a 5,000-person skilled worker visa quota.
stories.impact: New Zealand has committed to investing $20 billion in India over the next 15 years to boost bilateral economic relations.
stories.whats_next: India and Canada are scheduled to commence the fifth round of trade talks on October 5, 2026.

stories.title: US Sanctions to Ground Iranian Airlines Globally
stories.what_happened: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced that all Iranian airlines will be excluded from international operations beginning September 23. The new sanctions penalize foreign entities providing fuel, landing services, or tickets to these carriers by threatening their access to the US dollar system. According to The Hindu, the US and Iran have been at war since late February.
stories.impact: The measure effectively isolates Iranian aviation, forcing countries like Georgia to bar carriers and prompting service suspensions in locations such as Baghdad and Turkey.
stories.whats_next: US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping are scheduled to hold a summit on Thursday, according to The Hindu.

stories.title: IRGC warns of advanced weapons and new targets in event of US attack
stories.what_happened: The IRGC announced it will deploy new weapons and target previously unstruck American facilities if the United States resumes military action. Sources disagree on the timing of this statement, with News18 reporting it on Sunday and Hindustan Times on Monday. Additionally, News18 reported that Iran’s armed forces believe the US is preparing for renewed military action.
stories.impact: The announcement signals a shift in Iranian defense and counteroffensive operations, raising regional tensions following the identification of new potential strike targets.
stories.whats_next: President Trump mentioned he would probably be open to a meeting with Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian during an upcoming visit to the UN General Assembly.

stories.title: Typhoon Dujuan impacts East Japan
stories.what_happened: Typhoon Dujuan is moving toward East Japan's Pacific Coast at 20 kmph. According to Hindustan Times, the storm reached wind speeds of 144 kmph, causing power outages for over 9,000 households and 275 flight cancellations. One person was injured, and nine houses were damaged.
stories.impact: Over 1.6 million residents were urged to evacuate due to the typhoon, while the Asian Games equestrian eventing competition was postponed.
stories.whats_next: The equestrian eventing competition is scheduled to resume on September 22.

evidence.headline: India-New Zealand free trade agreement to take effect from Oct 20

published_claims.text: The India-New Zealand FTA will enter into force on October 20, 2026, coinciding with Vijayadashami.
The FTA was signed by India and New Zealand on April 27, 2026.
New Zealand committed to invest $20 billion in India over the next 15 years.
New Zealand will grant 100% duty-free access to all Indian exports.
India has excluded sensitive items from the FTA, including dairy products, onions, chickpeas, peas, corn, almonds, artificial honey, and sugar.
The agreement creates a quota for 5,000 skilled Indian professionals for temporary work visas.
The New Zealand Parliament approved the FTA on September 16, 2026, with a 93-29 vote.

evidence.headline: US Treasury warns of global blackout for Iranian airlines

published_claims.text: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent stated that all Iranian airlines will be shut down around the world on September 23.
Foreign companies and airports providing fuel, landing services, or tickets to Iranian carriers risk being knocked out of the US dollar system.

Iran responded to initial strikes by blocking the Strait of Hormuz.
The US imposed sanctions on all remaining Iranian airlines earlier in September.
Baghdad is suspending flights by Iranian airlines.
Georgia has barred Iranian carriers from its territory.
Mahan Air has suspended services to Turkey at the request of the Turkish government.
US President Donald Trump is scheduled to have a summit with Chinese leader Xi Jinping on Thursday.

evidence.headline: Flights scrapped, evacuations urged as Typhoon Dujuan nears Japan

published_claims.text: Typhoon Dujuan reached wind speeds of approximately 144 kilometres per hour on Monday.
Over 1.6 million residents were urged to evacuate due to the typhoon.
Japan Airlines and All Nippon Airways cancelled a combined 275 flights.
Over 9,000 households near Tokyo were left without power.
One person has been injured and nine houses damaged due to the typhoon.
The equestrian eventing competition at the Asian Games was postponed to September 22.
The typhoon was moving at a speed of 20 kmph in a northwesterly direction.
